name: InlineCTA
description: A call to action placed inside page content, such as between dashboard sections or at the end of an article: a title, a short description and one or two actions.
whenToUse: To suggest a next step in context, e.g. "Invite your team" under an empty member list.
To promote an upgrade or feature within a page without interrupting it.

whenNotToUse.text: For warnings, errors or system status.
For a page-wide announcement at the top.
When there is nothing yet on the page.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: A tile with an icon that hints at the offer.

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.description: The offer in a few words; a real heading.

anatomy.name: Description
anatomy.description: One or two sentences on the benefit.

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.description: One primary and at most one secondary action.

values.meaning: Default. A grey panel that sits quietly in content.
A brand-colored border and icon tile, for upgrades and new features.
Bordered, on the page background, for cards and dense layouts.
Default. Actions at the end; they wrap below on narrow screens.
Actions under the text, for sidebars and narrow columns.

states.name: Default
states.meaning: A static panel; its buttons have their own states.

behavior.text: In horizontal layout, actions wrap under the text when there is no room beside it.
The title is an h3 by default; set headingLevel to fit the page outline.
The icon sits on the right and actions on the left in Arabic.

content: Write the title as the benefit or the action: "Invite your team".
Use a verb on the primary button that matches the title.
Keep the description to two lines.

guidelines.dont: Stack several calls to action on the same page.

guidelines.do: Pair one primary button with an optional secondary.
guidelines.why: A single clear next step converts better.

guidelines.do: Use brand appearance for upgrades and new features.
guidelines.dont: Use the CTA to report errors.
guidelines.why: Status messages belong in an Alert so they are announced and colored by tone.

accessibility.role: region-less section with a real heading, so it appears in the heading outline.

aria.when: On the icon, which is decorative.

wcag.how: The title is a heading at a configurable level.
Text passes AA on every appearance in every theme.
Actions wrap under the text at narrow widths.

notes: Use Buttons or Links for actions so they keep their own focus and states.

examples.title: Invite your team
examples.description: Subtle, with an icon and two actions.

examples.title: Upgrade
examples.code:
import { Button, InlineCTA } from '@ds/react';

<InlineCTA appearance="brand" title="Unlock advanced reports" actions={<Button>Upgrade</Button>} />

examples.title: In a sidebar
examples.code:
import { Button, InlineCTA } from '@ds/react';

<InlineCTA layout="stacked" appearance="outline" title="Need help?" description="Our team replies within an hour." actions={<Button>Contact support</Button>} />

related.relation: Use when the page has no content yet.

components.name: InlineCTA
components.description:
A call to action placed inside page content, between sections or at the end of an article:
a title, a short description and one or two actions.

title.description: The offer in a few words, e.g. "Upgrade to Pro".

description.description: One or two sentences on why.

icon.description: Icon or illustration at the start.

actions.description: One or two Buttons or Links.

appearance.description: `subtle` (default) grey panel, `brand` tinted with the brand color, `outline` bordered.

layout.description: `horizontal` (default) puts actions at the end; `stacked` puts them under the text. Narrow screens always stack.

headingLevel.description: Heading level for the title. Default 3.

--inline-cta-padding-x.description: Gap between groups inside a section.

--inline-cta-border-radius.description: Controls and small surfaces: inputs, buttons, menu items.

--inline-cta-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--inline-cta-subtle-bg-color.description: App background behind cards and panels.

--inline-cta-subtle-border-color.description: App background behind cards and panels.

--inline-cta-brand-border-color.description: Regular tone outline, e.g. alert borders.

--inline-cta-brand-icon-bg-color.description: Subtle tinted background for a tone, e.g. alerts, selected items, badges.

--inline-cta-outline-icon-bg-color.description: App background behind cards and panels.

--inline-cta-icon-border-radius.description: Controls and small surfaces: inputs, buttons, menu items.

--inline-cta-icon-color.description: Main tone-colored text on light or tinted backgrounds: titles, active items.

--inline-cta-text-gap.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.

--inline-cta-description-text-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.
